repairs_verified.canonical_wire_contracts: Runtime upload/download ports and durable commit receipts use the exact additive v3 snake_case schemas; receipts include retention_class and retain_until and both runtime shapes validate through the synchronized contract authority.
repairs_verified.trusted_object_identity: The application derives the immutable object key from trusted account, workspace, project, revision, lane, job, and artifact identity. Additive migration 0020 independently reconstructs that complete key and rejects every mismatch.
repairs_verified.least_scope_ports: Capabilities bind reservation, principal, method, exact path, content type, content length, checksum, expiry, and bounded uses. Forgery, replay, expiry, partial bytes, length drift, and hash drift fail closed.
repairs_verified.durable_receipts: Receipts are immutable, reservation-bound, callback-idempotent, expiry checked at commit, tenant-scoped by receipt hash, and preserve hash, technical probe, retention, and deletion-owner facts.
repairs_verified.non_enumeration: The active v3 plane exposes no list, copy, move, or global hash lookup. Identical tenant filenames and hashes do not collide or reveal existence; an accepted immutable key cannot be replaced.
repairs_verified.retention_and_deletion: The fake adapter and database reject foreign deletion, deletion before retain_until, and LEGAL_HOLD deletion. Only one owned tombstone is allowed.
repairs_verified.legacy_firewall: The superseded raw-key route is retained only as an explicitly composed fixture and fails construction without the literal legacyFixtureOnly firewall. The exported active control-plane contract is v3 tenant identity; no global raw-key production route remains live.
repairs_verified.worker_ports_and_scratch: Mage and SoulX worker I/O factories accept only exact scoped v3 GET/PUT ports. /runpod-volume is application-read-only policy, while caches, config, temp, locks, and outputs remain under one job-local scratch tree.
repairs_verified.filesystem_negatives: Traversal, internal and ancestor symlinks, simulated different-device mounts, exact model-volume paths, crash leftovers, and success, failure, cancel, timeout, signal, and refresh cleanup are covered and green.
